diagnosis: The route handler deletes third-party Slack integration credentials based solely on the integrationId route parameter. While fastify.authBearer ensures the requester is logged in, it never verifies whether the integration belongs to the requester's workspace. Any user can disconnect and revoke Slack bots for other organizations.
